sentences.text: If a silent shadow follows you at night in Kerala... don't look back.
The old tales say sinister sorcerers once prowled the dark palm groves.
Legends claim these shadowy figures could twist their bones into the shape of a massive beast.
Travelers walking home late would hear heavy, unnatural footsteps pacing just behind them in the fog.
Suddenly, a terrifying roar would shatter the midnight silence as the creature charged.
By morning, only a broken lantern and a disturbed trail of red clay remained on the lonely path.
The villagers knew better than to search the dark woods for whoever vanished into the night.
Would you turn around if heavy footsteps started chasing you?
